diagnosis.narrative: The series carries a strong long-run trend. Seasonality is strong (period 52): a repeating cycle explains much of the movement. Predictability is middling — structured signal and irregular noise are balanced. The series reads as stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (19 points, ~1% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.306), which favours a weighted combination.
